name.zh: 静默即时检测

change.zh: 即时检出 0 % → 95 %，检测 1 s；仅启用检测时回到现有干净 CKPT 并用全局恢复；漏检仍 120 h 后发现
change.en: immediate detection 0 % → 95 % after 1 s; the job rolls back to the last checkpoint and runs the global recovery; the remaining 5 % are still found after 120 h

name.zh: 干净状态恢复与 step 重算

change.zh: 已即时检出的静默从全局 CKPT / 3 min 恢复 → 易失干净 step 状态 / 1 s 恢复，最多重做 1 s 计算；不缩短漏检的兜底
change.en: a detected corruption recovers from the volatile clean step state in 1 s and redoes at most 1 s instead of the global checkpoint recovery; the fallback for undetected corruption is unchanged

name.zh: 通信 / 算子重执行

change.zh: 瞬态中断先重执行：90 % 在 5 s 成功且不回滚；失败耗时 10 s 后进入后续恢复链
change.en: transient interruptions are re-executed first: 90 % succeed in 5 s without rollback; a failure costs 10 s and continues down the chain

name.zh: 进程 / Pod 重调度

change.zh: 适用中断 95 % 在 60 s 重建进程，仍全局暂停并回滚 CKPT；失败 120 s 后全局 CKPT
change.en: 95 % of applicable interruptions rebuild the process in 60 s (global pause, rollback to the checkpoint); a failure costs 120 s before the global recovery

name.zh: DP 域弹性恢复

change.zh: 适用中断 98 % 局部恢复成功：50 域中一个域 180 s 不可用，全局协调 1 s；状态冗余避免回滚；失败 120 s 后后续全局恢复
change.en: 98 % of applicable interruptions recover locally: one of 50 domains is out for 180 s, the job pauses 1 s to re-synchronise; redundant state avoids rollback; a failure costs 120 s before the next rung

name.zh: 缩短 CKPT 周期和保存阻塞

change.zh: 每计算 300 s 保存 4 s → 每计算 60 s 保存 1 s；同时改变保存开销与回滚
change.en: save 4 s every 300 s of compute → save 1 s every 60 s; both the save overhead and the rollback change

name.zh: 4 平面 × 两层，radix 1,024，每 NPU 4 × 200G（主算例）
name.en: 4 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 4 × 200G per NPU (main case)

basis.zh: HC2026：昇腾 960 超节点集群两层 Clos、四平面；星河 UBG 交换机 radix 最高 1,024；附件把它用于 950；950 白皮书允许 2 × 400G UBoE 拆成 4 × 200G
basis.en: HC2026: Ascend 960 SuperPoD clusters use a two-tier, four-plane Clos; Xinghe UBG switches have radix up to 1,024; the attachments apply this to 950; the 950 white paper lets the 2 × 400G UBoE split into 4 × 200G

name.zh: 2 平面 × 两层，radix 1,024，每 NPU 2 × 400G

basis.zh: 950 白皮书 2 × 400G UBoE，每口一个平面
basis.en: 950 white paper 2 × 400G UBoE, one plane per port

name.zh: 2 平面 × 三层，radix 128（51.2T），每 NPU 2 × 400G（HAC-D 模板默认）
name.en: 2 planes × 3 tiers, radix 128 (51.2T), 2 × 400G per NPU (HAC-D template default)

basis.zh: HAC-D a950-ub2 模板默认（综述 2.6 节）；交换机数与券商 UBoE 约 39,000 台同量级
basis.en: HAC-D a950-ub2 template default (survey §2.6); switch count of the order of the broker figure for UBoE (≈ 39,000)

name.zh: 附件方案：每 NPU 1 × 800G，按轨分到 4 个平面，radix 128，按 Clos 自洽所需层数
name.en: the attachments’ scheme: 1 × 800G per NPU, rails spread over 4 planes, radix 128, as many tiers as a Clos needs

basis.zh: 附件写作“两层四平面”、64 口叶 + 128 口脊；每平面 12.8 万个端点时两层 radix 128 只能接 64 × 128 = 8,192 个，须三层
basis.en: the attachments call it “two tiers, four planes” with 64-port leaves and 128-port spines; with 128,000 endpoints per plane two tiers of radix 128 reach only 64 × 128 = 8,192, so three tiers are needed

name.zh: 主算例 + 叶层 2:1 收敛
name.en: main case with 2:1 at the leaves

basis.zh: 附件架构五（推理 PD 分离）的 2:1 收敛，仅作对照

basis.en: the attachments call it “two tiers, four planes” with 64-port leaves and 128-port spines; with 128,000 endpoints per plane two tiers of radix 128 reach only 64 × 128 = 8,192, so three tiers are needed
